scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/api && npm test --prefix apps/web
